title: nuten
description: Settings of nuten, a formatter for Nushell, as a dprint plugin.

locked.description: Whether the configuration is not allowed to be overridden or extended.

associations.description: Glob patterns of more files to format with nuten, besides those it claims by extension; a pattern starting with `!` leaves a file out.

lineWidth.description: Columns a line may take before it breaks where it can.

useTabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs instead of spaces.

indentWidth.description: Columns per indent level, and per tab when indenting with tabs.

newLineKind.description: What ends each line; line breaks inside a string, a bare word, or an `@example` block stay as written.

oneOf.description: Follows the first line break outside a string, a bare word, or an `@example` block.
Uses carriage return and line feed.

commas.description: Where a `,` goes among the items of lists, records, tables, parameters, and type parameters.

oneOf.description: Between items, and also after the last item when they break over lines.
